carry_forward_constraints: S40 must not treat N3, CP-N3-C or CF-3 as passed merely because S39 is the level integrator. S39 is REPAIR_REQUIRED with 52 findings and CF-3 remains blocked.

S40 architecture must start from actual immutable artifacts/interfaces, not the stage-name list in S39. Bind intake, ER, graph, feature, model, queue and governance components to versions/hashes and contract tests.
Preserve S39's no-autofraud boundary as an executable policy: architecture boundaries must prevent score/ranking from becoming fraud, guilt or relationship verdicts.
Evidence is not a feature name. Architecture must keep observed source evidence, graph-path evidence, model features/contributions, uncertainty and human decisions as distinct entities with lineage.
Every graph path crossing a bounded context must retain node/edge IDs, source evidence, graph snapshot/version and as-of time.
Do not carry packet_ok truthiness semantics into APIs/domain objects. Score zero is valid when in domain; NaN/nonfinite/out-of-range inputs fail closed.
Thresholds/calibrators are versioned artifacts, distinct from each other. Their owning bounded context and compatibility contract must be explicit.
SemVer is only meaningful after a public contract/API is declared. Do not infer SemVer validity from dotted strings; define compatibility and consumer contract tests.
Ownership must be resolvable and auditable, not a free-form string. Each architecture component and policy artifact needs an owner/escalation path.
Human decision/override actions use a closed enum and durable append-only audit events with actor, reason, timestamp and artifact/policy versions.
Appeal is a separate workflow/state with prior-decision reference and reviewer-separation rule; it cannot be represented by the same in-memory decision list.
Feedback events must preserve label source/time and training eligibility to prevent temporal leakage and feedback-loop contamination.
Responsible-AI/security gates are evidence-backed controls, not booleans: RBAC, PII minimization, secrets, SSRF/input policy, fairness and no-autofraud must link to actual tests/results.
Fairness architecture must support harm-specific disaggregated metrics, subgroup support and uncertainty; slice_metrics=True is invalid evidence.
Distinguish input/data drift from performance/calibration/concept drift. Architecture should represent drift events with metric, reference/current snapshots, threshold, value and time.
human_only must be an enforced operating policy that blocks automatic actions, not a display string.
Rollback is a compatibility-checked release bundle (model, calibrator/threshold, feature/reference, policy as applicable), not an arbitrary previous-model string.
S40 should define domain/bounded-context boundaries without erasing cross-cutting traceability required for CF-3: artifact IDs, hashes, run IDs, case IDs and evidence IDs must remain linkable.

Carry systematic pytest from S27: S40 contract tests must include S39 false greens for packet score domains, invalid thresholds, decision enum, release boolean self-attestation, drift events, rollback existence and metric domains.
Do not cite S39's current Theory playground as N3 evidence: it is still an off-topic CI/CD monitoring simulator.
Model/data/system cards and CF-3 manifests are substantive versioned artifacts; type names or strings are not documentation evidence.
S40 must not 'architect away' unresolved S27-S39 debt. A cleaner diagram does not make broken evaluation, fairness, performance, resilience or CF-3 evidence valid.
